title: Machine Learning Engineer
jd:
Machine Learning Engineer (2-4 years), Orbit Retail, Hyderabad
Own models from experiment to production.

Required
- 2+ years of experience shipping ML models to production.
- Strong Python and model training experience (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow).
- SQL and data pipeline skills.
- Experience with model deployment and monitoring (MLOps).

Good to have
- A/B testing and experimentation.
- Cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
